method: 2026-11-07 modrooms reuse sub-lane. 481 candidate roles pruned by name/desc to 184 plausible (fantasy/military/rite/smith/regional-sacred and non-modern furniture dropped); 30 low-value siblings then cut for the agy budget (listed in rejected as 'not read'). 177 skus (each role's first sku plus 23 alternate looks) rendered once in Blender 5.0 headless (tools/reuse_render.py: EEVEE, 256 px, 35 deg elevation / 30 deg azimuth 3/4 camera, bounding-sphere framing; flat rugs projected onto a ground plane in PIL), down-sampled to a table-distance effective size (10 px per inch of longest side, clamped 110-256), shuffled (seed 1107) and tiled 30 per numbered sheet (tools/reuse_read.py). 6 blind agy-run (Gemini) calls, one per sheet, no room or expectation given: object + alt, era modern|neutral|historical, conf 0-100, reason, old-fashioned cues. Rule (tools/reuse_decide.py): accept a sku if era is modern/neutral and conf >= 70; listed cues reviewed by hand; 8 hand overrides in reuse-overrides.json (also in 'overrides'). Unread variants whose render differs < 0.09 (mean abs, 24 px) from an accepted read sku of the same role ride along as near_duplicates_unread. Sheets, keys and raw reads: /mnt/usb/turnip-works/lanes-2026-11-07/modrooms/reuse/.
